title: Placements Module: Edit Placement From the Admin | Orchard Core
description:
Placement rules decide where the shapes of a page appear, and they usually live in a placement.json file of a module or a theme, so changing a rule means changing the project.

The Placements module edits the same rules from the admin, saves them with the site, and moves them between sites with recipes and deployment plans.

In this video:
• How placements from the admin apply over placement files
• Enabling the Placements features
• Creating a placement in Design, Placements
• Opening a placement from the settings of a content type
• Saving placements in the database or in a file
• Moving placements with recipes and deployment plans
